overall_explanation: Reviewed root_session.rs against the existing admission/dispatch contracts (pair_admission.rs, root_dispatch.rs, spawn.rs Status). The pump is bounded as claimed: at most 4 accept attempts per poll alternating over the fixed [UnixListener; 2], at most 2 pending tickets (slot check precedes every accept), no blocking receive (AdmissionTicket::take_result uses try_recv), and every fatal accept/admission failure, dispatch failure, non-Running pair status, completion and Drop route through cancel(), which fences the pair, closes both listeners and drops pending tickets (whose Drop cancels their control). Listener index never feeds role/generation; authority still comes only from the admission worker's kernel identity match and RootDispatch::start's owns/used/generation checks. The WouldBlock branch on admit is effectively unreachable (queue occupancy is bounded by pending count), so no legitimate child socket is dropped there. Private-field access from the nested session module and its tests is valid (descendant modules), and the #[allow(dead_code)] on root_dispatch covers the nested module for strict Clippy. Test helpers refactored in root_dispatch_tests.rs preserve prior behavior (listening + fixture_streams::<3>). Test sequencing in pending()/ready() is deterministic given FIFO backlog ordering and the pump's ticket-before-accept ordering. Size within the seven allocated paths is 652 added+deleted (under target 700); the Rust tree at HEAD matches the frozen proof tree b7275b0c. The runner correctly chains the predecessor scripts and the 29 command exits are present. No actionable defects found.
